programme.title: Past Hunters: The Haunted Parade
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Hoylake and investigate a building known as The Parade. Dating back to 1909, this once former school, still seems to have ghostly pupils and teachers taking class.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: A Social Club for the Paranormal
programme.desc: Bex and Sean delve deep into a building that has survived world wars and is home to some very social ghosts. They come face to face with an angry spirit too, and something strange appears to be lurking in the basement.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: House of Hauntings
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension's Bex and Sean head to New Mills and investigate a home situated on the grounds of death and destruction from the bombings of WW2. Will any of the spirits lost in this disaster come forward and make contact during the investigation today?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!
programme.desc: Huldra lokker alle guttene ut av hotellet og frister med stor makt. Hvem lar seg lokke av den vakre, men farlige skikkelsen?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!
programme.desc: Huldra Lene Angelica har trollbundet flere av guttene på hotellet. Maiken lar sjalusien ta overhånd og gjør ting hun ikke burde.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!
programme.desc: Et viktig valg skal tas og gruppepresset på hotellet har aldri vært større. Det blir temperatur på kveldens parseremoni når sannheter kommer fram i lyset.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!
programme.desc: Det er afterski på hotellet, det blir både opp- og nedturer når en alpinist rokker om på alle parene. Stemningen er i taket når festen sparkes i gang med en imitasjonskonkurranse.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!
programme.desc: Det flørtes heftig på festen og en krangel bryter ut før leggetid. Markus og Maiken gjør noe de fort skal få angre på.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!
programme.desc: Etter en fuktig kveld på afterski brer fylleangsten seg utover hotellet. Et taktisk valg fører til en tårevåt parseremoni. Men er alle tårene ekte?

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 906
programme.desc: Karianne får et viktig oppdrag med å hjelpe alenemamma Samia i hus før mammapermisjonen er over – men holder budsjettet? Hans Christian møter Johanna og Joakim som er på jakt etter drømmehagen.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1001
programme.desc: Ingrid bor på leilighetshotell med sine to barn, og er desperat etter å få en ny start, og skape et hjem sammen med familien. Småbarnsforeldrene Toril og Eivind vil ut av leiligheten sin i Oslo-gryta.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1002
programme.desc: Lise og Damien blir snart tobarnsforeldre og vil ut av bykjernen og ned på bakkeplan. Cecilia starter i ny jobb i Trondheim om to uker, men har ikke hatt tid til å gå på visninger.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1003
programme.desc: Ole Jørgen og Gina er førstegangskjøpere på begrenset budsjett, og drømmer om en fredfull og landlig enebolig til seg og kattene. Oda og Simon har noen spesielle utfordringer med sin nåværende bolig.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1004
programme.desc: Alenemoren Ragnhild og sønnen Julius sover i dag i køyeseng, og trenger desperat større plass. Christina og amerikanske Justin har mange krav på lista, og Karianne tar utfordringa på strak arm!

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 404
programme.desc: Det er konkurransedag på Camp kulinaris, og første deltaker må reise hjem. Mia står overfor et vanskelig valg når hun skal velge førstelærling. Alle deltakerne må kjempe om plassen sin i en lærlingkamp.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 405
programme.desc: Det er en ny uke på Camp kulinaris og det betyr ny meny og ny restaurantsjef. Gruppa reagerer med sjokk da de finner ut hvem som skal lede gruppa denne uka.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 406
programme.desc: Restaurantsjef Lothe fortsetter sin tilbakelente lederstil og negative holdning til ukas meny. Det får konsekvenser når Kjartan kommer på ukas menysmaking.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 407
programme.desc: I dag er det servering på Camp kulinaris. Lothe har tatt det rolig hele uka, men bestemmer seg nå for å ta tak. Men er det tidsnok? Amalie utpekes som Lothes høyrehånd men Tom vil også bestemme.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 408
programme.desc: Det er tid for valg og konkurranse på Camp kulinaris. Lothe skal velge førstelærling og det står mellom tre stykker. I dagens lærlingkamp blir deltakerens smaksløker satt på prøve.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 409
programme.desc: Det er ny uke og ny meny på Camp kulinaris, men det er knyttet stor spenning til hvem som skal lede gruppa. Uka blir annerledes når Kjartan har med seg en overraskelse.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 904
programme.desc: Vi blir kjent med Fitness-jentene Christine og Anne-Catrine som skal ned til Gran Canaria for å trene i sol og varme.

programme.title: Charterfeber After Beach: Episode 106
programme.desc: Fetsund-gutta ser tilbake på gårsdagens fest før de bestemmer seg for å lage en ny en samme kveld. Mario, Sofie og Marthe drar også ut på byen der de møter Fetsund-gutta.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 916
programme.desc: Som vanlig er det mye som skjer på Gran Canaria. Bjørge har omvisning på hotellet, mens Hilde prøver å lage en eventuell evakueringsplan på sitt hotell.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1018
programme.desc: Fred Åge og Sven Erik er på delfinsafari. Familien Haider tar turen til gocartbanen. Gjengen fra Radio Kvinesdal sliter med teknikken før live-sendingen, og Svein og Linni prøver å finne en karaokebar.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 917
programme.desc: Sommeren går mot slutten på Gran Canaria, og de ferieglade turistene prøver å få med seg mest mulig før hjemreise.

programme.title: Charterfeber

programme.desc: A woman was brutally murdered in her home and the only witnesses to the crime were the family dogs. An expert in canine behavior was convinced the killer knew both the victim and the animals, and he was determined find out what the dogs had seen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shattered Innocence
programme.desc: This killer probably hoped to cover his tracks by staging the crime scene. But investigators saw through the attempt almost immediately and turned to forensic science to learn what really happened that night.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Driven to Kill
programme.desc: A serial rapist targeted women. His dark urges raged out of control and led him to murder. He followed a path so random it was impossible to trace, and all that tied him to his crimes were his access to the highways and a bizarre sexual fetish.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Secrets
programme.desc: Two young boys were the only witnesses to their mother's murder. The horrible crime appeared unmotivated, senseless and random.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Without Remorse
programme.desc: A small town without any crime was turned inside out by the arrival of one dangerous stranger. Some killers are cold and calculating; others are impulsive, unpredictable, and hard to pin down.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hidden Agenda
programme.desc: Across the Midwest, a band of armed robbers struck banks at the rate of nearly one per month. They attacked with lightning precision and lethal force. They were in and out in five minutes.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dixie Mafia
programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: The New Detectives: True Crime
programme.desc: They know as much about crime as any crime fighter, or any criminal. They're the crime writers, and through their eyes we see murder most foul.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trails of Evidence
programme.desc: In criminal investigations, a simple clue can provide the missing link by placing a suspect at a crime scene. Dirt left on shoes, tires or clothes, or even a tiny piece of plastic can pinpoint a crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Material Witness
programme.desc: Lies and deceit can often throw investigators off the trail of justice. But when hard evidence contradicts a killer's story, police must use the clues to piece together the truth.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Unlikely Sources
programme.desc: Some of the best clues come from the least likely places. Baffling crimes have been solved and criminals betrayed through evidence provided by insects, beer bottles, and other seemingly meaningless objects.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Camera Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Photography: Forensic photographers are among the first people at a crime scene, capturing vital clues on film. What do the cameras capture that can't be seen first-hand, and who are the men and women who analyze the camera's clues?

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Dead Man Falling
programme.desc: When a family of four is brutally murdered, it sends a shockwave of fear through the town. Police believe they have a spree killer on their hands, until Lt. Joe Kenda discovers a gruesome connection.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Fall From Grace
programme.desc: Hikers come across a horrific scene: the corpse of a man left nude, beaten and bound in the mountain wilderness.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: With Friends Like This
programme.desc: A young man is found gunned down outside his home. Sgt. Joe Kenda and Det. John Anderson must determine whether the killer was a complete stranger, a barrio gang member, or a jealous lover.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Blood On the Tracks
programme.desc: When an unsuspecting train conductor discovers a decapitated body on a lonely stretch of track, Lt. Joe Kenda must unravel the mystery of his death.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Make My Day
programme.desc: When Keith Andrews is killed, a man steps forward claiming he did it in self-defense—but Lt. Joe Kenda has his doubts.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landing on Mars
programme.desc: Mars sparks our curiosity like no other planet because it is so reachable. Despite having landed there, most of the information we gather is still done by instruments in the planet's orbit.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Living with Space
programme.desc: Astronauts and Cosmonauts train and study for years to work and live aboard the International Space Station. With this wealth of experience and insight behind them what do they think when they return to Earth?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Atmosphere
programme.desc: Our atmosphere is an unbelievably complex machine that protects us from the vacuum of space, shelters us from harmful radiation and allows us and the biosphere to breath; we need to learn much more about it so we can better it.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Flight Status
programme.desc: The next 12 months will see an intense rise in flight tests, demonstration launches and high priority flights. Some are on time others are not. We check the flight status of some of this new hardware and these new capabilities.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Invasion Mars
programme.desc: For over 50 years we have bombarded Mars with our probes and landers. Spying from orbit to map terrain, finding her strengths and weaknesses. The time nearing for the full scale invasion of the planet, when humans walk on Mars and claim it for their own.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Juno, Cassini and Beyond
programme.desc: The Amazing Cassini spacecraft and its sibling lander, Huygens, have now concluded their scientific studies, bringing back years of data. Now, Juno piercing the cloak of Jupiter and her distant relative New Horizons at the edge of the solar system.

programme.title: The Mystery of Dark Matter
programme.desc: Dark matter, which is unknown and undetectable in our physical models, would appear to populate the cosmos on a massive scale. For the first time, a film portrays the wild scientific quest that dark matter gives rise to - a real thriller!

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Beginning of the End, Apollo Gets Complicated & The End of Apollo
programme.desc: The Beginning of the End - After the first Moon landing the Apollo science program was about to start in earnest but people were losing interest. Apollo Gets Complicated - New technology is added that extends the reach of the Apollo program.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 504

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 505

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 506

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 507
programme.desc: 13. desember 2008 skjer det som omtales som den verste brannen i Oslo siden krigen, i Urtegata på Grønland. Det ble fort mistenkt at brannen var påsatt.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 508

programme.title: Henry Danger: Bøttefella

programme.desc: En Grafitti-gjeng spraymaler overalt i Swellview. Mens de leter etter lederen blir Kid Danger fristet av en søt jente i gjengen til bli med og droppe Captain Man. Programnote: 1 time.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Henry og den Tøffe Jenta - Del 2 av 2
programme.desc: Kid Danger er forsvunnet og blitt med i grafitti-gjengen som spraymaler hele Swellview. Captain Man forsøker desperat å finne ham og lederen av gjengen, Van Del. Programnote: 1 time.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Jaspers Virkelige Kjæreste
programme.desc: Sommerkjæresten til Jasper kommer for å bo hos Charlotte. Hun blir sjalu når hun tror at Charlotte er forelsket i Jasper. Charlotte begynner å lure på om hun er riktig klok.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Rammende Rytmer
programme.desc: Når Dr. Minyak kommer tilbake, er Henry i fare når han skjønner at hans beste venn, Charlotte, er forvandlet til en slem, supersterk person som har som mål å fange Kid Danger og Captain Man.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Én Henry, tre Jenter: Del 1
programme.desc: Mens Captain Man forsøker å fange The Mad Granny, en bestemor som terroriserer Captain Man når han opptrer offentlig, blir Henry tvunget til å sjonglere mellom arbeidslivet og sitt romantiske liv.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Én Henry, tre Jenter: Del 2
programme.desc: Planene til Henry for skoledansen 'The Meatball' kompliseres når han må møte opp som Kid Danger. Når skoledansen topper seg blir han tvunget til å ta en dramatisk avgjørelse.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Henry & Hakkespettene
programme.desc: Når basketball-treneren til Piper slutter, blir Henry den nye treneren. Mens han prøver å piske laget i form blir han utfordret av 'The league board' og deres uortodokse regler.

programme.desc: Etter at Sam plutselig må i fengsel, lover Carly og Freddie dyrt og hellig å ikke avlyse nettshowet ettersom faren hennes skal se det. Carly ber Spencer om hjelp, men det blir vanskelig, for han skal på date.

programme.title: iCarly: Vi avlyser ikke

programme.title: iCarly: Freddie flytter ut

programme.desc: De medvirkende introduserer bloopers og bortklipte scener fra serien.

programme.title: iCarly: Ja
programme.desc: Etter at en iCarly fan frir til kjæresten på nettshowet, blir gjengen nesten tvunget til å gå i bryllupet. Men når bruden får kalde føtter, må Carly komme til unnsetning.

programme.title: iCarly: T-skjortesalg
programme.desc: Gjengen begynner å selge Penny-skjorter, og når salget går susende, rekrutterer Sam barn fra 4. klasse for å bidra til å lage t-skjorter. Men Carly, Sam og Freddie er uenige om hvordan de skal behandles.

programme.title: Awkward: My Love is a Black Heart
programme.desc: Jenna forbereder seg på sin første valentinsdag med kjæreste, men både hun og Tamara blir sjalu ved tanken på at eksene deres kanskje er kommet over dem.

programme.title: Awkward: What Comes First: Sex or Love?
programme.desc: Jenna kommer ikke over Jakes kjærlighetserklæring og lurer på om hun vil finne ut av følelsene sine dersom hun har sex med ham.

programme.title: Awkward: Another one Bites the Dust
programme.desc: Jenna er endelig sikker på hva hun føler for Jake og fast bestemt på at tiden er inne. Hun støter imidlertid på hindringer i form av tante Allys bryllup, en mann fra morens fortid, og renkesmeden Sadie.

programme.title: Awkward: Time After Time
programme.desc: Dårlig timing og en serie avsløringer gjør både Jenna og Jake sønderknuste.

programme.title: Awkward: Homewrecker Hamilton
programme.desc: Jenna prøver å rydde opp i kjærlighetslivet sitt da en uventet tekstmelding retter søkelyset mot alle problemene hennes.

programme.title: Awkward: Pick Me, Choose Me, Love Me
programme.desc: Etter at bloggen hennes ble lansert, mener alle noe om Jennas privatliv. Men mens andre følger med for underholdningens skyld, vil Jake og Matty ha svar.

programme.title: Awkward: Once Upon a Blog
programme.desc: Jenna lar fantasien løpe løpsk på bloggen. Ved å undersøke og dikte opp en annen versjon av fortiden prøver hun å forutse fremtiden.

programme.title: Awkward: The Other Shoe
programme.desc: Jennas beslutning om guttene blir offentlig og når hun også får reise til Europa ser alt ut til å gå hennes vei. Men det skjer noe som får Jenna til å tvile på om det alltid er så lurt å få alt man ønsker seg.

programme.title: Awkward: Cha-Cha-Cha-Changes
programme.desc: I løpet av junioråret opplever Jenna en bølge av overraskelser og forandringer som kan komme til å få følger for fremtiden hennes.

programme.title: Awkward: Responsibly Irresponsible
programme.desc: En klassekamerat dør, og Jenna tenker over det inntrufne, sørger og tar ansvar for noe hun har holdt hemmelig for Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: A Little Less Conversation
programme.desc: Matty blir fjern når han finner ut om Jennas mulige graviditet, og Jenna er villig til nesten hva som helst for å slippe å prate om det.

programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Radical Agenda
programme.desc: In the 1970's a string of bank robberies and bombings spread fear and destruction along the east coast. The FBI faced a new breed of criminal, the domestic terrorist.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Game
programme.desc: In the 1970s and 80s, people went to Alaska looking for a fresh start, to reinvent themselves, or to disappear for a while. Some of those disappearances weren't by choice.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Silent Strike
programme.desc: Money may not be the root of all evil, but for some men, a million dollars is enough to justify murder. Even men sworn to uphold the law can sometimes be tempted.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Crime Spree
programme.desc: They swept through six states like a plague, thrill killers acting without rhyme or reason. They targeted adults and young girls, kidnapping, and murdering. And in their rampage, they left plenty of clues, but moving targets are the hardest to hit.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Camera Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Photography: Forensic photographers are among the first people at a crime scene, capturing vital clues on film. What do the cameras capture that can't be seen first-hand, and who are the men and women who analyze the camera's clues?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Trust
programme.desc: Poison is the subtlest form of death, and investigators must see through unusual circumstances to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Family Plots
programme.desc: Every family has its secrets, and sometimes blood relations lead to bloodshed. When murder becomes a family affair, investigators must turn to forensics to uncover family plots.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murderous Attraction
programme.desc: In Columbus, Ohio, a woman is found shot in the head. The death is ruled a suicide, but something is not right and detectives refuse to let the matter rest.

programme.title: The New Detectives: For Love Or Money
programme.desc: Every family has its secrets, and sometimes blood relations lead to bloodshed. When money is the motive, murder can rip at the very foundation of marriage and family.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Make My Day
programme.desc: When Keith Andrews is killed, a man steps forward claiming he did it in self-defense—but Lt. Joe Kenda has his doubts.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: .357 Magnum
programme.desc: The murder of a popular teen at a crowded house party sends Kenda down a winding road paved with lies, misdirection, and innuendo.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Rearview Mirror
programme.desc: When a retired military man runs over a pedestrian, it’s up to Lt. Joe Kenda to determine if it was bad brakes or bad intent.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Shot Through the Heart
programme.desc: 15yr old Chuck returns home from school to find his mother, Betty Limbrick, shot dead on the floor. Evidence points to a robbery gone wrong, but Kenda uncovers a plot almost too shocking to believe.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Blood Sisters
programme.desc: The bullet-ridden bodies of two sisters are found in a suburban house that’s littered with mysterious clues. Joe Kenda learns that the two unassuming young mothers shared an explosive secret.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Victim Zero
programme.desc: A brawl erupts at a local bar ends with the shooting death of a army solider. To unravel the murder, Lt. Joe Kenda most infiltrate a revered military institution, and expose a dangerous vendetta.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Beginning of the End, Apollo Gets Complicated & The End of Apollo
programme.desc: The Beginning of the End - After the first Moon landing the Apollo science program was about to start in earnest but people were losing interest. Apollo Gets Complicated - New technology is added that extends the reach of the Apollo program.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Shuttle Program, The Challenger Disaster & Return to Space
programme.desc: The Shuttle Program - The first re-useable spacecraft. The Challenger Disaster - Pressing launch schedules lead to carelessness and the loss of the Challenger. Return to Space - A re-designed shuttle is back in space with a redefined role.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle
programme.desc: The Space Shuttle Matures - The Space Transportation System changes the nature of orbital missions. Complex Construction in Space - Confidence in the shuttle begins to return and engineers for get the lessons of the past.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Milky Way
programme.desc: This episode traces our view of the Milky Way, from the mythology of ancient sky watchers to the efforts of scientists to map it from the inside out.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Big Bang
programme.desc: Throughout history, our nightly view of the universe has fueled our collective imagination. When it comes to the Big Bang, not even the most creative work of imagination can rival what science has revealed about the birth of the universe.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Hot Zone
programme.desc: Mercury is one Earth's closest neighbors, but for centuries it eluded astronomer's best efforts to learn its secrets. But that has changed thanks to missions like Mariner and most recently, Messenger.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rays
programme.desc: Cosmic rays can tell us much about the universe. They are not simply another form of light, but carriers of information about powerful and unseen processes at work thousands or even millions of light years away.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Fermi Paradox
programme.desc: The Fermi Paradox asks the ultimate question: Given a few reasonable assumptions about the chance of life arising elsewhere in the universe and the distance between the stars, why has an alien civilization not presented itself?

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landsat
programme.desc: Take a look at Landsat 8, the advanced planetary explorer with a 900 million dollar price tag! It is designed to peer across multiple wavelengths to reveal complex and ever-changing details that are undetectable by the human eye.

programme.title: The Truth is in the Stars
programme.desc: Does our society have the capacity to live up to Star Trek's optimistic vision for humanity's future? William Shatner takes us on a journey to find out whether art has imitated life in the years since the world-renowned TV series premiered in 1966.

programme.title: Cops: Sidewalk Licker
programme.desc: A prostitution sting in Las Vegas nets more than just johns, police respond to reports of a woman licking the sidewalk, and a patrol happens on a lovers' row in a parking lot.

programme.title: Cops: From Sixty to Zero
programme.desc: A motorcyclist fleeing police slams into a pickup truck at high speed, and a man being frisked invents an interesting story to explain the suspicious bulge in his pants.

programme.title: Cops: First Time Caller

programme.title: Cops: Kicking and Screaming
programme.desc: An intoxicated man suspected of domestic abuse refuses to obey deputies' orders, police find drugs in a woman's car, and an alleged prostitute encounters the police.

programme.title: Cops: Mixed Emotions
programme.desc: A traffic stop escalates to a dangerous situation, a woman admits to hitting her dad in the face with her teeth, and a defiant driver doesn't want deputies to search his car.

programme.title: Cops: Better Safe Than Sorry

programme.title: Cops: Funny Money
programme.desc: Cops pursue a man skipping bail, an impaired driver is surprisingly cooperative, and officers struggle to remove a violent offender from a crime scene.

programme.title: Cops: Pants Down, Hit the Ground
programme.desc: A man learns a hard lesson about wearing his seatbelt, and police perform a traffic stop and uncover a sad man with a strange story.

programme.title: Cops: One, Two, Tree

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Christophe Lejard Case
programme.desc: The lifeless body of Christophe Lejard is found by his son just metres from their home. The man was shot in the head as he was getting into his car to go to work. An execution, which at first glance doesn't square with the profile of a quiet family man.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: Deathly Fatal Passion At the Hotel (Villermet case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Céline Marchand Case
programme.desc: On May 30th 2015 in Sorinières, Yann Machand reports his wife Céline Marchand missing.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 508
programme.desc: Etter en fest i juli 2017 forsvinner Tom Rune Hagen. Han har vært en del av et belastet rusmiljø, men akkurat denne uka har han planlagt en tur på fjellet for å fiske. Hva skjedde med Tom Rune?

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 101
programme.desc: Anne Elisabeth Hagen forsvinner sporløst fra sitt hjem høsten 2018. På en rød stol finner ektemann og milliardær, Tom Hagen et trusselbrev og krav om løsepenger.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 102
programme.desc: Åtte år gamle Monika Sviglinskaja blir funnet død i sitt hjem på Sotra. Politiet mener det dreier seg om et selvmord og henlegger saken. Men moren hennes er fortsatt overbevist om at noe kriminelt har skjedd.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 103
programme.desc: To turgåere finner et utbrent lik på et bål langs en øde skogsbilvei på Veståsen i Søndre Land. I flere uker står politiet helt uten svar på hvem som kan stå bak den groteske handlingen.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 104
programme.desc: 10. august 2019 opplevde Norge nok et rystende terrorangrep. 21 år gamle Philip Manshaus dreper først sin 17 år gamle stesøster. Bevæpnet, og med uniform går han deretter til angrep mot Al-Noor moskeen i Bærum.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 105
programme.desc: Tina Jørgensen forsvant etter en kveld på byen i Stavanger. En måned senere finner politiet liket av en 20 år gammel kvinne. Hvem kan ha tatt livet av Tina og deretter dumpet henne langs en øde veistrekning?

programme.title: Modern Marvels

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: A visit to Russia's formerly secret training center for cosmonauts and what it's like to prepare for a space flight.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: The history of long-duration life in space from the first Soviet station to Skylab to Mir to the International Space Station; what it is like to live in space, as well as the monumental obstacles engineers and astronauts overcame to make it possible.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Vehicle assembly; building a home in a week; high-tech golf clubs; building demolition.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Adrenaline runs high when Adam Richman visits the factory where Yamaha makes ATVs, WaveRunners and more; an inside look at a company built to get people sky-high in paramotors; amusement park Diggerland USA; mech-suits; submarine built for two.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: While blade implements have been in use since the Paleolithic Age, the discovery of metallurgy allows people to forge stronger, more versatile blade implements, including axes, swords and knives; an axe-throwing contest in Wisconsin; a sword fighter.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Captain Man: På Ferie
programme.desc: Ray stoler på at Henry og Charlotte beskytter Swellview mens han er i brullup hos sin kusine. Problemer oppstår når de må ordne ting på egen hånd.

programme.title: Henry Danger: The Time Jerker
programme.desc: Når Kid Danger og Captain Man sloss mot Time Bandit faller Kid Danger tilfeldigvis inn i tidsmaskinen til Time Bandit og opplever den samme dagen om og om igjen.

programme.desc: Med en invitasjon til den beste restauranten i Swellview bestemmer Henry seg for å ta med seg sjefen sin, Ray. Det blir mer komplisert enn han forventet.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Sjalue Henry
programme.desc: Etter at Jasper blir hyllet som en lokal helt blir Henry sjalu for at Kid Danger blir takket og ikke ham selv.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Jul med Danger
programme.desc: Når Captain Man blir arrestert for tyveri blir han nødt til å tilbringe julen i fengsel. Henry og Charlotte må prøve å hjelpe Captain Man så han får en fin jul i fengselet.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Uskadelige Henry: Del 1
programme.desc: Når Kid Danger blir skadet på et oppdrag, bestemmer Henry seg for å bli like uovervinnelig som Captain Man. Men ting blir ikke helt som Henry hadde håpet at det skulle bli.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Uskadelig Henry Del 2
programme.desc: Når Henry får en uventet skavank, må han skjule den for familien mens gjengen jobber med å få ham tilbake til normalen.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Tekst, Løgner og Video
programme.desc: Når en video av Henry og Ray, der de blir til Kid Danger og Captain Man, kommer ut må Henry kjempe for å få den tilbake slik at ikke hemmeligheten hans blir avslørt.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Motsatt Univers
programme.desc: Henry og Charlotte blir transportert inn i et omvendt univers hvor Ray og Schwoz er onde og prøver å ødelegge Piper. De må stoppe onde Ray og onde Schwoz og finne ut hvordan de skal klare og komme seg tilbake.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Danger & Thunder Del 1
programme.desc: Captain Man, Kid Danger og Phoebe Thunderman infiltrerer et hemmelig skurkemøte i Smellview hvor skurkene planlegger og skade Captain Man og Kid Danger. På møtet oppdager Phoebe uventet gjest - broren Max.

programme.title: South Park: Fantasilandet I

programme.desc: Robbie is such a good house guest that Annie and Matt feel underappreciated.

programme.desc: Mary sneaks back to Glenoak and Eric is right on her tail.

programme.desc: Lucy gets jealous when her new love interest asks her to set him up with another girl.

programme.title: 7th Heaven
programme.desc: Lucy's first date turns out to be an ex-boyfriend reunion.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The oldest, and longest running movie theatre in Kentucky is now owned and operated by someone who never once thought about ghosts. However, a shocking experience with a woman dressed in white altered his belief in the supernatural forever.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvete Promo
programme.desc: Bli med inn hvis du tør. På dagtid besøker vi ekstremsamlere og spøkelsesjegere, mens vi om natten skrur opp stemningen med skrekkfilmer og går inn i de mest skremmende hjemsøkte husene.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Drakelow Tunnels
programme.desc: The Drakelow Tunnels are a former underground military complexused mainly for storage. However, during the construction and running of this facility, 6 people are thought to have died.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Razor Ruddock's Home
programme.desc: We visit the home of Soccer legend Neil "Razor" Ruddock which seems to be haunted. Is it his home specifically? Or are these ghosts attached to him?

programme.title: Past Hunters: Blackpool Pleasure Beach
programme.desc: Blackpool Pleasure Beach is one of the most visited attractions in the United Kingdom. People visit it not only for the fun, but to also hopefully catch a glimpse of the many ghosts that haunt there.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Whitby Hall
programme.desc: Built in the early 1800s, Whitby Hall used to be an administrative center and now stands as a public park and arts center. It has never before been investigated, but staff have reported many noises and presences among them.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: Sakai battles the 'conjurer of garlic,' a chef who embraces the pungent ingredient as real Italians do. Sakai is further challenged to use live squids in the dishes.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: Three years after losing to Iron Chef Chen, the Italian restaurant Sabatini demands a rematch, this time sending in the master chef of their Tokyo restaurant.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: Led by Tadamichi Ohta, the chef who defeated Sakai, the Ohta faction invades Kitchen Stadium to uphold traditional Japanese cuisine. Fuji is team Ohta's first contender against Morimoto.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: In honor of the Girls' Festival, Kaga invites a challenger from the ancient city of Kamakura, Motohito Kondo, who was trained in Kyoto and is an expert in both tea and sake.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: Tasaki is a world champion sommelier who has always dreamed of becoming a famed chef. Chairman Kaga decides to grant him his wish.

programme.title: The Jersey Devil

programme.title: Monsters

programme.title: Robson's Extreme Fishing Challenge: Episode 2
programme.desc: Robson Green travels the World challenging the best fisherman to catch the biggest, best fish across the planet.

programme.title: Gone Fishin
programme.desc: Fishing the Hauraki Gulf with Damo aboard Diversity. Snapper, dolphins, whales, and winter magic make for a special charter trip.

programme.title: Monster Carp
programme.desc: In an action-packed angling adventure in Central Europe, crazy guy Ali Hamidi is joined by fellow carp fanatics Neil Spooner and Tom Dove as they tackle the mighty Lake Balaton.

programme.title: Monster Carp
programme.desc: The Extremadura region was where the Romans first introduced carp to Spain, and this rugged area now has a reputation for producing some massive ones from the huge lakes.

programme.title: Gone Fishin
programme.desc: How easy is it to hook a shark from the beach? Find out as the team braves summer surfcasting to show sharks are just a cast away.

programme.title: IFISH: Carp on Fly - Wyangala Dam, NSW
programme.desc: Mud Marlin, Bogan Bonefish. Call them what you will, European Carp are a whole lot of fun when it comes to casting a fly. Amazing takes, line burning runs and some incredible site fishing... and that is just the begininning.

programme.title: IFISH: Wyangala Dam, New South Wales
programme.desc: Whether you want to troll lures for cod, collect your own live bait and target yellas, or battle huge mud marlin on small soft plastics - Wyangala Dam is the place to be.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 3407
programme.desc: Jimmy er en sjenerøs fyr med et stort hjerte som ofte hjelper folk rundt seg. Dessverre har sjenerøsiteten hans nå ført til at hans egen økonomi har kollapset.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 3408
programme.desc: Maries økonomiske problemer begynte da hun som nyskilt ble bedt om å kjøpe en ny sofa, og siden den gang har kredittkortgjeld og inkassokrav hopet seg opp.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2401
programme.desc: I sesongpremieren av Luksusfellen Sverige treffer vi tidligere deltaker i Big Brother, Hanna Widerstedt, som lever luksuriøst i Berlin, til tross for en inntekt på 3000 kroner i måneden.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2402
programme.desc: Tobarnspappa Magnus på 38 elsker å shoppe biler og duppeditter, og rekkehuset hans utenfor Stocholm er proppfullt av teknisk utstyr. Alt er kjøpt med svindyre kredittlån.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2403
programme.desc: Fredrik bor sammen med kjæresten i Bollnäs, og sløser bort enorme summer på gatemat, tobakk og spill. Han lar være å åpne regninger, og eier dessuten tre biler, som han ikke vet hvor er.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2404
programme.desc: Carolin fra Mellerud drømmer om et liv med lange feriereiser og store innredningsprosjekter. Men akkurat nå er den drømmen veldig langt unna.

programme.title: The Last Face
programme.desc: En regissør (Charlize Theron) fra et internasjonalt hjelpebyrå i Afrika møter en lindringshjelpsjef (Javier Bardem) midt i en politisk / sosial revolusjon, og møter sammen tøffe valg om humanitærisme og liv gjennom sivil uro.

programme.title: My One and Only
programme.desc: En hardtarbeidende mor tar med seg barna på en utfordrende roadtrip etter mannens svik.

programme.title: I'm Not There
programme.desc: I'M NOT THERE er en ukonvensjonell reise gjennom Bob Dylans liv og musikk. Filmen beskriver Dylans mange sider og identiteter. I en serie sammenvevde historier portretterer seks forskjellige skuespillere Dylan i ulike tidsepoker.

programme.title: Mean Guns
programme.desc: Heller enn å drepe sine fiender, finner en gangsterboss på en mer kreativ løsning. Han bestemmer seg for å låse alle inn i et fengsel og gir dem våpen og lar dem drepe hverandre. Kampen står om en premie på 10 millioner dollar til de siste vinnerne.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Secrets
programme.desc: Two young boys were the only witnesses to their mother's murder. The horrible crime appeared unmotivated, senseless and random.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death In The Delta
programme.desc: When a wealthy young woman was abducted in front of her in-laws' home, the police had no shortage of suspects. The 25-year-old victim left behind a tumultuous marriage, an ex-husband and old boyfriends. All were on the FBI's short list.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Lost Boys
programme.desc: In June of 1997, a crime wave swept Iowa like a tornado. It left a trail of robbery, kidnapping, and murder in its wake, and then it moved on. No one knew where.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Threat
programme.desc: A suspected drug dealer would stop at nothing to keep local and federal authorities from building a case against him. When his organization started targeting the government itself, federal agencies went on high alert.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: En inspirerende fortelling om basketballtrener Ken Carter, som fikk både ris og ros da han skapte overskrifter med å sette hele sitt ubeseirede lag på benken på grunn av dårlige akademiske prestasjoner.

programme.title: Z for Zachariah
programme.desc: I etterkant av av en verdensomspennende atomkrig er Ann Burden (Margot Robbie) en overlevende. Ann frykter lenge at hun er det eneste gjenlevende mennesket på jorden, inntil hun oppdager noe helt forbløffende: et annen menneske.

programme.title: The Arrival
programme.desc: Astronomen Zane oppdager intelligent utenomjordisk liv, men romvesenene holder på en dødelig hemmelighet og gjør hva som helst for å hindre Zane i å få vite den.

programme.title: Couples Vacation
programme.desc: På randen til havari i ekteskap og karriere drar den arbeidsløse forfatteren Jack Spencer og hans kone Amanda på ferie. Med en uventet dobbeltbooking blir den private, romantiske luksusen alt annet enn privat og romantisk.

programme.title: Modern Persuasion
programme.desc: En singel kvinne med fokus på karrieren i New York blir tvunget til å forholde seg til følgene av et mislykket forhold når ekskjæresten hennes hyrer inn hennes reklamebyrå.

programme.title: Bedazzled
programme.desc: Elliot Richards er en uheldig ung mann fortært av ubesvart kjærlighet, og desperat etter å forandre livet sitt, gjør han en avtale med djevelen som slu lover å gjøre nettopp det - for en pris.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Hindsight is 20/40
programme.desc: Et bilde skaper dramatikk mellom Mary Jane og Andre. Patrick meddeler at han flytter ut. Et dopkjøp blir voldsomt. Niecy kommer med en plan som følger hennes leveranse. Kara grubler over fordelingen av sønnene sine.

programme.title: Boomerang: The Let Out
programme.desc: Ari inviterer gjengen ut når han er vert for en fest på en av Atlantas heiteste nattklubber. Der prøver Simone å få Tias nye singel spilt av en DJ. I en uventet vri, kysser Bryson og Simone hverandre for første gang.

programme.title: Boomerang: Homecoming

programme.title: Forensic Files: Yes, In Deed
programme.desc: It was a tragic twist of fate. Just days after a woman sold her home and moved to a modest trailer, a fire took both the trailer and her life. But the autopsy proved this was no accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Guarded Secrets
programme.desc: A security guard disappeared from his post without a trace; his remains were found a year later in a remote campsite.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smoking Out a Killer
programme.desc: A college senior was found raped and murdered near an unpaved footpath used by students to walk from one side of campus to the other.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Frozen Assets
programme.desc: In 2004, Mary Ann Clibbery was found brutally murdered at her Illinois business. Investigators had to determine if this was a robbery gone wrong or a calculated murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: House Hunting
programme.desc: In 2006, Texas real estate agent Sarah Anne Walker was found brutally murdered in a model home. Weeks later, a witness came forward who may have seen the killer. Police used forensic hypnosis to help him recall every detail of the man's appearance.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shoot to Thrill
programme.desc: In 2003, St. Cloud teenager Jason MacLennan returned home after a night out with friends and discovered his father's body lying in a pool of blood.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Political Thriller
programme.desc: In 2006, Nevada politician Kathy Augustine died mysteriously during a re-election campaign. The medical examiner could neither isolate the cause of death, nor explain the tiny puncture wounds discovered during the autopsy.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Double Cross
programme.desc: In 1996, Virginia Beach police arrive at the Makdessi apartment to find the bloodied bodies of Elise Makdessi and Navy sailor Quincy Brown. But was Brown Elise's lover or her assailant?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dancing with the Devil
programme.desc: In 1999, Patrick McRae was found dead in his Des Moines home and the crime scene was awash with blood. Analysis showed it had come from two people, one of whom was female.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Last Dance
programme.desc: In 2000, the body of exotic dancer Rachel Siani was found beneath a New Jersey bridge. Investigators wondered if she had committed suicide. They discovered that Rachel offered to assist a drunk customer named John "Jack" Denofa to his motel room.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Constructive Criticism
programme.desc: In 2000, construction manager Darrell North was found dead in his work trailer in Ft. Worth, Texas. When investigators arrived, they found that he had been stabbed 46 times, indicating a personal relationship between the victim and the attacker.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Crime Spree
programme.desc: They swept through six states like a plague, thrill killers acting without rhyme or reason. They targeted adults and young girls, kidnapping, and murdering. And in their rampage, they left plenty of clues, but moving targets are the hardest to hit.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Heist
programme.desc: In Arizona, an armored van loaded with cash failed to reach its destination. Authorities suspected an inside job. When the vehicle was recovered with the drivers and the cash missing, those suspicions grew even more.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Firefight
programme.desc: In Miami, a gang of robbers targeted banks and armored cars. They carried assault weapons and weren't afraid to use them. They struck during the day, and sometimes twice a day. For awhile, they seemed unstoppable.

programme.title: The New Detectives: For Love Or Money
programme.desc: Every family has its secrets, and sometimes blood relations lead to bloodshed. When money is the motive, murder can rip at the very foundation of marriage and family.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Mind Hunters
programme.desc: Psychological Profiling: Journey into the dark recesses and calculated madness present only in our worst nightmares, and in the minds of serial killers.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Partners In Crime
programme.desc: They say that a burden shared is a burden halved, but when partners team up to commit murder, the weight of their guilt remains just as heavy. Investigators must rely on forensic science to capture partners in crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Trust
programme.desc: A New York homebuyer gets more than he bargained for when a house inspection turns up a mummified corpse. For decades, the crime had gone undiscovered. The victim unmissed, and the killer unpunished.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tools Of Death
programme.desc: Tool marking: A tool used to commit a crime can often be the same tool used to solve it. The pattern a machine leaves on an item, the unusual way a tool crimps a wire, and even something as innocuous as the shape of a wood chip can lead to a killer.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Victim Zero
programme.desc: A brawl erupts at a local bar ends with the shooting death of a army solider. To unravel the murder, Lt. Joe Kenda most infiltrate a revered military institution, and expose a dangerous vendetta.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: A Killer Always Rings Twice
programme.desc: When 22 year-old Micki Filmore is found raped and murder in her apartment, detective Kenda focuses his investigation on her activities the previous night.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: I Now Pronounce You Dead
programme.desc: Mother of 3 Dianne Hood is shot to death by a masked gunman on her way home from a Lupus support meeting. Joe Kenda uncovers a sordid web of lust and greed, revealing a killer no one ever expected.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Death Rains Down
programme.desc: Restaurant worker Sharon Coleman is murdered in a hail of large caliber gunfire. Kenda must break through a web of lies to hunt down one of the most dangerous criminal masterminds he’s ever faced.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Fractured Glass
programme.desc: When affable ladies’ man Michael Tittemore is gunned down in the dead of night, Kenda first sets his sights on the roommates who were present during the murder.

programme.title: The Truth is in the Stars
programme.desc: Does our society have the capacity to live up to Star Trek's optimistic vision for humanity's future? William Shatner takes us on a journey to find out whether art has imitated life in the years since the world-renowned TV series premiered in 1966.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Sling Shot
programme.desc: Soviet Luna 3 was the first to use gravity to change course to photograph the dark side of the Moon. NASA Mariner 10 used the technique to swing by Venus to target Mercury. The gravity sling shot maneuver has become a standard for space navigation.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Living Planet
programme.desc: We have been observing Earth for 40 years now, in the last 20 we have focus with intensity on the planet with new technologies and capabilities, we have accumulated a mass of data that is now revealing a complex and ever changing living planet.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Cosmic Collisions
programme.desc: Space is vast, yet it is full of collisions. Gas and dust electrostatically flock together, and gravity takes over coalescing grains into rocks. Those rocks become boulders, then asteroids colliding again and again, striking planets and each other.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Gravity
programme.desc: Gravity keeps us on the ground and the planets in their orbits, yet we only notice it when it's not there. In space we cheat gravity; falling just as fast but missing the ground. Now this fundamental universal force is slowly giving up its secrets.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Interface
programme.desc: The interface between Earth and space is the Ionosphere, a region of rarified gas and charged particles. It is very important for radio communications, radar, satellite signals and global positioning. Yet we know so little about it.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Windows to Other Worlds / Fountain of Creation
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 105
programme.desc: Tina Jørgensen forsvant etter en kveld på byen i Stavanger. En måned senere finner politiet liket av en 20 år gammel kvinne. Hvem kan ha tatt livet av Tina og deretter dumpet henne langs en øde veistrekning?

programme.title: Svenske krimsaker: Episode 601
programme.desc: Den 14. november 2019 forsvinner sytten år gamle Wilma, og hele Uddevalla blir involvert i forsvinningen. Etter noen dager blir det funnet blod i hennes og kjærestens leilighet, men Wilma er fortsatt savnet.

programme.title: Svenske krimsaker: Episode 602
programme.desc: En regnfull morgen den 19. oktober 2004 dreper en ukjent mann en åtte år gammel gutt og en 56 år gammel kvinne i Linköping. Gjerningsmannen forsvinner sporløst og politiet må nå finne ut hvem han er.

programme.title: Svenske krimsaker: Episode 603
programme.desc: Politiet har ikke gitt opp å oppklare dobbeltdrapet i Linköping. Etter en endring i svensk lov i 2019, har politiet nå muligheten til å bruke kommersielle slektsdatabaser for å finne gjerningsmannen.

programme.title: Svenske krimsaker: Episode 604
programme.desc: En 33 år gammel mann blir funnet skutt og drept nær Sundsvall. Det viser seg å være en mann med mange fiender, og politiets liste består i begynnelsen av over femti personer med mulige motiver.

programme.title: Svenske krimsaker: Episode 605
programme.desc: Den 12. juni 2017 blir et eldre par funnet brutalt drept på deres gård utenfor Mantorp. Viktige brikker i puslespillet i jakten på morderen viser seg å være teiprester, så vel som usedvanlig store skoavtrykk.
